title: eval-harness: add per-prompt regression CI hook + metrics integration
author: Avery Chen
description: Motivation: add a lightweight per-prompt regression CI hook that runs a targeted eval-harness job for changed prompt-sets and prevents regressions that exceed configured quality thresholds. This PR implements the hook, integrates per-prompt metrics into the existing CI metrics pipeline, and exposes a configurable quality gate (default: 1.5% relative regression on primary eval metric) that will fail the PR if triggered. Key points: - New CI hook (eval-harness/per-prompt) that detects changed prompt-sets and invokes the eval runner with the baseline pinned to main. - Per-prompt metrics emitted to metrics/ci with consistent tags (prompt_set, model_variant, pr_number) for downstream dashboards and alerting. - Configurable gate via .eval-config in repo root: teams can opt-in/override thresholds and tolerances per prompt-set. - Local smoke runner and unit tests included to keep CI fast: the hook runs a quick sample + full-run on the merge pipeline. - Rollout plan: feature gated behind opt-in flag in org CI config; gradual enablement for core repos first. Checklist: - [x] Implement per-prompt CI hook and runner integration - [x] Emit per-prompt metrics with tags - [x] Add unit + integration tests for hook detection logic - [x] Add docs for .eval-config and threshold tuning - [x] Add CI job definitions (pr / merge stages) - [x] Validate on redwood repo with staged runs Changeset: small to medium; most work is orchestration and metrics wiring. Backwards compatibility: no breaking changes to public eval-harness APIs; new CI hook is opt-in. Testing: added unit tests for detection logic, integration test that runs a sample prompt-set on a small model in CI container; perf-smoke run added to merge pipeline to detect extreme regressions. Related: ENG-3412 (per-prompt gating), ENG-3413 (CI metrics plumbing), SUP-887 (reported regression incident that motivated per-prompt checks). Merge: squashed and merged after approvals and green CI. See review thread for discussion on threshold defaults and noise handling.

review_comments: Samir Patel: Nice approach. Two questions: 1) how do we avoid flapping on noisy prompts? 2) can we run only a small sample for PRs to keep CI fast?
Avery Chen: Answered - default gate uses relative % with smoothing window=3; PR job runs sampled subset (configurable) and the merge job runs the full prompt-set. Added docs and config options.
Marisol Gomez: Please add tags for model_variant and prompt_set to metrics so we can filter in dashboards. Also please ensure metrics include baseline commit hash.
Avery Chen: Done. Metrics now include baseline_commit and model_variant tags. Added unit test to validate emitted tags.
Liam O'Connor: Approving pending CI green and a small note about threshold default; low risk for opt-in rollout.
Marisol Gomez: Approved. CI is green on the final run.
release_notes: Adds an opt-in per-prompt regression CI hook that runs targeted eval-harness checks and emits per-prompt metrics used for quality gating. Default gate set to 1.5% relative regression on primary eval metric; configurable via .eval-config.
summary: Implements per-prompt regression CI hook, metrics integration, docs and tests. Opt-in, safe rollout; used to prevent prompt-set regressions detected in SUPPORT incident SUP-887.
